coupling_convention: d_e, dimensionless (scalar coupling to electron mass)
notes: NANOGrav 15-year data set searches for ultralight dark matter (ULDM) coupled to SM particles, deriving 95% CL constraints on the d parameters (Eq. 64) over mass range ~1e-24 to 1e-20 eV (Fig. 14) and vector ULDM models (Fig. 15). Local DM density assumed 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (Table 1). The paper constrains MULTIPLE scalar couplings (d_e photon, d_me electron, d_mu muon, d_g gluon) plus vector B-L type couplings, so the coupling_type is ambiguous — could be ScalarPhoton, ScalarElectron, ScalarNucleon, or VectorBL. The abstract highlights constraints for ULDM coupled to electrons, muons, or gluons. Numerical data points appear only in exclusion figures (Figs. 14, 15) with no tabulated values in the provided text, so no reliable (mass, coupling) pairs can be extracted.
